items.text: Houston (early week): TBD - RB David Montgomery (groin, out since Wk5, may return to practice), OT Braden Smith (ankle, inactive Wk9), S Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand, likely misses 3rd straight). IR - WR Jaylin Noel, WR Jayden Higgins (season), DT Mario Edwards Jr. No new injuries from the 44-22 win over LAC. C.J. Stroud expected to start.
items.source: Yahoo Sports (Texans surge after bye, Nov 9)

items.text: Cleveland QB: Deshaun Watson cleared concussion protocol and is expected to return as QB1 per ESPN's Fowler (Shedeur Sanders started Wk9), but Monken has not officially named a starter. Monitor - DT Maliek Collins (illness, sat Wk9). IR - OL Teven Jenkins, LB Jeremiah Owusu-Koramoah, DT Kalia Davis (season).
items.source: ESPN (Browns returning to Watson as QB1 in Week 10, Nov 9)
